traits: Strong pioneer spirit signaling new beginnings.
Cannot tolerate injustice; possesses a straight and upright character.
Has leadership qualities and finds it difficult to be subordinate.
Excessive stubbornness can sometimes lead to self-righteousness, so flexibility is needed.
GAP.name: Gap (甲)
GAP.nature: Straight & Upright - The spirit of a soaring giant tree
GAP.lifePurpose: To open paths that did not exist and to become a shelter for others through personal growth.

traits: Excellent adaptability to the environment and strong practical tendencies.
Appears soft on the outside but possesses strong tenacity and survival instincts inside.
Creative and sensible, skilled in communication and harmony with others.
Lacks decisiveness and can be easily swayed by the surrounding environment.
EUL.name: Eul (乙)
EUL.nature: Persistence of weeds and vines that bend but do not break
EUL.lifePurpose: To bloom one's own flower even in harsh environments and create a lush garden in solidarity with others.

traits: Enjoys attention with an open and refreshing personality.
Passionate and progressive, values courtesy and honor.
Emotions are easily visible on the face, and does not hold grudges.
Can be hot-tempered and chase extravagance without substance.
BYEONG.name: Byeong (丙)
BYEONG.nature: Radiant passion and fairness of the sun illuminating the world
BYEONG.lifePurpose: To shine light in dark places and warm others' hearts with one's passion.

traits: Devoted and warm, possessing delicate sensitivity and insight.
Polite and calm on the outside, but hides explosive passion inside.
Pursues spiritual values and has excellent talent in religion or arts.
Thinks too much, tormenting oneself, or can be timid and sensitive.
JEONG.name: Jeong (丁)
JEONG.nature: A candle lighting the darkness and a hot flame within the heart
JEONG.lifePurpose: To explore invisible truths and heal wounded souls with one's warmth.

traits: Heavy and prudent; has the tenacity to push through once decided.
Broad tolerance, acting as a sturdy pillar for people around.
Conservative, values credit like life, and pursues stability over change.
Can be overly stubborn and blunt, leading to communication breakdown.
MU.name: Mu (戊)
MU.nature: The weight and faith of a high mountain embracing all things
MU.lifePurpose: To become an unshakeable standard and a foundation where life can grow within that embrace.

traits: Simple and diligent, finds joy in taking care of and educating others.
Values substance and has excellent meticulous and realistic sense.
Strong self-defense mechanism and tends not to reveal true feelings easily.
Can appear petty due to suspicion and calculating practical benefits too much.
GI.name: Gi (己)
GI.nature: Benevolence like mother earth nurturing all things
GI.lifePurpose: To cultivate the possibilities of surroundings into real fruits, just as growing a small seed into a giant tree.

traits: Deep loyalty, cherishes relationships once formed, strong camaraderie.
Possesses cool-headed criticism and decisiveness, skilled in establishing discipline.
Appears cold on the outside but is warm and pure inside.
Can point out others' faults too sharply or reveal destructive tendencies.
GYEONG.name: Gyeong (庚)
GYEONG.lifePurpose: To establish order amidst chaos and solidify the essence by cutting away the unnecessary.

traits: Strong self-esteem and neat, possessing aesthetic sense and refined manners.
Delicate and sensitive, easily spots others' mistakes, thorough self-management.
Cynical and prickly, but inner self is more fragile and easily hurt than anyone.
Can be obsessed with small things or tire oneself with excessive perfectionism.
SIN.name: Sin (辛)
SIN.nature: Splendor of a polished jewel and a sharp blade
SIN.lifePurpose: To constantly polish oneself to become a jewel of the world below, and remove absurdities with sharp insight.

traits: Large scale, quick thinking, skilled in humor and improvisation.
Yearns for freedom and has a wanderer's temperament not bound anywhere.
Good tolerance and gathers people well, but sometimes has unfathomable darkness.
Lacks patience and may start things without finishing them.
IM.name: Im (壬)
IM.nature: Vastness of the endlessly flowing sea and wisdom that makes things flow
IM.lifePurpose: To make stagnant places flow and harmonize all values of the world with immense tolerance.

traits: Wise and deep-thinking, captures environmental changes faster than anyone.
Quietly takes care of practical benefits and has very strong intellectual curiosity.
Appears compliant but has persistence to penetrate silently towards goals.
Prone to daydreaming, severe mood swings, and slow decision-making due to weak heart.
GYE.name: Gye (癸)
GYE.nature: Humble and intellectual wave of rain and dew wetting all things
GYE.lifePurpose: To quench the world's thirst and thirst, and convey invisible principles of life through intellectual exploration.
